BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is hereby amended
by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 6-F in the area bounded by
The public alley next north of and parallel to West 27" Street; a line 96.60 feet west of and parallel
to South Princeton Avenue; West 27" Street; and a line 120.60 feet west of and parallel to South
Princeton Avenue.

to those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 310 West 27" Street
